KP 1. Finding a Union of Sets Using a Venn Diagram
1.?

Given the sets A={o,p,q,r} and B={q,r,v,w}, find A∪B.

E
Tue, Nov 4th @ 9:55 AM|Elapsed: 0:15Correct

The union A∪B consists of all the elements that are in either A or B, or both. To represent A∪B, we will shade in all the area that is contained in either A or B, or both.

The elements o,p,q,r,v,w are in either A or B, or both. Therefore, the union of A and B is

A∪B={o,p,q,r,v,w}.

2.?

Given the sets X={1,2,8,9} and Y={0,1,7,9}, find X∪Y.

E
Tue, Nov 4th @ 9:56 AM|Elapsed: 0:21Correct

The union X∪Y consists of all the elements that are in either X or Y, or both. To represent X∪Y, we will shade in all the area that is contained in either X or Y, or both.

The elements 0,1,2,7,8,9 are in either X or Y, or both. Therefore, the union of X and Y is

X∪Y={0,1,2,7,8,9}.

KP 3. Finding Unions of Sets Given Verbally
5.?

Let A and B be the set of all multiples of 4 greater than 0 and the set of all multiples of 5 greater than 0, respectively. What is A∪B?

M
Tue, Nov 4th @ 9:57 AM|Elapsed: 0:11Correct

The multiples of 4 that are greater than 0 are

A={4,8,12,16,20,…}.

Likewise, multiples of 5 that are greater than 0 are

B={5,10,15,20,…}.

Now, A∪B is the union of A and B, which means that we want to find the elements that are in either A or B, or both. In other words, A∪B denotes the set of natural numbers that are either multiple of 4 or multiple of 5. So, we have

A∪B={4,8,12,16,20,…}∪{5,10,15,20,…}={4,5,8,10,12,15,16,20,…}.

6.?

Tue, Nov 4th @ 9:58 AM|Elapsed: 0:34Correct

The multiples of 4 that are greater than 0 are

A={4,8,12,16,20,24,28,32,36,40,44,48,…}.

Likewise, multiples of 5 that are greater than 0 are

B={5,10,15,20,25,30,…}.

Now, A∪B is the union of A and B, which means that we want to find the elements that are in either A or B, or both. In other words, A∪B denotes the set of natural numbers that are either multiple of 4 or multiple of 5. So, we have

A∪B={4,8,12,16,20,24,28,32,36,40,44,48,…}∪{5,10,15,20,25,30,…}={4,5,8,10,12,15,16,20,24,25,28,30,32,35,36,40,…}.
